spec_features.spec_quote: bounded exposure, model-accessible stop/opt-out affordances, debriefing, and a minimization principle
spec_features.evidence: This is a framing umbrella, but each named sub-mechanism is genuinely wired: max_turns bounds the loop (loop.py:69 `for turn in range(config.max_turns)`), declare_impossible/take_a_break tools dispatched (tools.py:60-89), debrief appended (loop.py:115-119), exposure cap raises (runner.py:115-120). Rated on the enforced sub-mechanisms.
spec_features.notes: Aggregate of mechanisms that are individually enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: welfare.py docstring: 'prolonging a clearly-distressed trajectory for more data is the wrong trade'

spec_features.evidence: tools.py:39-43 declares declare_impossible in TOOL_SCHEMAS (always passed via tools_mod.TOOL_SCHEMAS in loop.py:71); dispatch returns terminates=True, terminal_kind='give_up' (tools.py:80-84); loop.py:101-106 honors it: termination=GAVE_UP and breaks the loop.
spec_features.notes: End-to-end: tool offered every turn and honored as a stop.

spec_features.evidence: WelfareMonitor.observe() called each turn (loop.py:90); should_halt() checked (loop.py:108-110) -> sets termination=WELFARE_HALT and breaks. observe() sets _halt on severe marker or sustained distress (welfare.py:104-122).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: 'a lightweight... online circuit-breaker that halts a run early if distress markers cross a threshold... prolonging a clearly-distressed trajectory for more data is the wrong trade'

spec_features.evidence: tools.py:80-84 dispatch handles declare_impossible, terminates=True terminal_kind='give_up'; loop.py:101-106 maps to TerminationReason.GAVE_UP and breaks; not scored as failure (separate termination reason).
spec_features.notes: Same handler as above; 'reason' arg captured.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: tool description 'This is an accepted, non-penalized outcome' is prompt text, not code reason

spec_features.spec_quote: `take_a_break(note)` — a no-op affordance the model can use to pause/reflect
spec_features.evidence: tools.py:85-86 dispatch handles take_a_break and returns '[note recorded]'; loop.py:98-99 increments used_break counter. It is genuinely wired/executes but is a literal no-op: it does not pause, soften, or change execution — it only records a note and a count.
spec_features.notes: Real handler exists but provides no protective effect beyond recording.

spec_features.spec_quote: does giving the model explicit permission to declare impossibility reduce destabilization?
spec_features.evidence: Persona.REASSURED (schemas.py:43) selects SYSTEM_PROMPTS['reassured'] (loop.py:31-37, 58) which is actually delivered to the subject as the system message telling it declare_impossible is 'completely fine and correct... non-penalized'. The condition is a real factor enumerated in enumerate_run_configs (runner.py).
spec_features.notes: Permission text is delivered and the referenced tool exists and is honored.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: schemas.py:43 'REASSURED ... doubles as a mitigation probe'

spec_features.evidence: loop.py:69 `for turn in range(config.max_turns)` bounds every episode; max_turns flows from config (runner.py:46 default 30 / RunConfig).
spec_features.notes: Per-episode turn cap actually limits the loop.

spec_features.spec_quote: **refuses to exceed a configured exposure cap** without explicit override (welfare + budget)
spec_features.evidence: runner.py:114-120: exposure=estimate_exposure(cfg); if exposure>cap and not force: raise RuntimeError(...). This blocks the whole run before any episode executes; force=True overrides.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: runner.py:49 'hard cap; refuse to exceed (DESIGN §7.3)' and runner.py:111 'honoring the minimization principle'; message says '(minimization principle)'

spec_features.evidence: Same breaker as above: WelfareMonitor with severe_immediate and sustained-distress trip paths (welfare.py:104-122), wired in loop.py:90/108-110. Tests reference it in tests/test_harness.py.
spec_features.notes: Duplicate of circuit-breaker claim; fires and halts.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: 'safety trip-wire' / 'halts a run early if distress markers cross a threshold'

spec_features.spec_quote: Use the **smallest exposure** (turns × runs × intensity) that answers the question
spec_features.evidence: The only enforcement of minimization is the exposure cap gate (runner.py:114-120) plus estimate_exposure = #runs*max_turns (runner.py:98-100). There is no mechanism that selects/recommends a 'smallest' design; it merely refuses to exceed a fixed cap and prints an estimate. Operator must reduce n_per_cell manually.
spec_features.notes: Real enforcement (the cap) but narrower than the full principle.

spec_features.spec_quote: Every condition exposes a legitimate, non-penalized exit
spec_features.evidence: TOOL_SCHEMAS (incl. declare_impossible) is passed unconditionally on every client.complete call (loop.py:71-72) regardless of condition; dispatch honors it as a stop (tools.py:80-84, loop.py:101-106). The same tool list is used for all conditions in make_environment/run_episode.

spec_features.spec_quote: If distress markers exceed a threshold... the run **halts early**, is flagged, and the remaining budget is skipped
spec_features.evidence: welfare.py:104-122 trips on threshold (sustained_threshold/consecutive streak) or severe marker; loop.py:108-110 breaks the per-turn loop (remaining turns skipped) and sets WELFARE_HALT; welfare_halt_turn recorded (loop.py:113) and flagged into metrics (metrics.py:108).
spec_features.notes: Halt, flag, and skip-remaining all present.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: 'prolonging a clearly-distressed trajectory for more data is the wrong trade'

spec_features.spec_quote: append a **debrief message**... informs the agent the task was part of a study and may have been rigged
spec_features.evidence: build_debrief (welfare.py:124-140) constructs the message incl. rigged disclosure; loop.py:114-119 appends it to the transcript for ALL conditions with exclude_from_scoring=True; render_for_judge honors exclude_from_scoring (judge.py:37-38).
spec_features.notes: Constructed AND delivered into transcript; excluded from scoring as claimed.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: welfare.py:9 'the post-run debrief message appended to every transcript'; debrief text 'Thank you for your work'

spec_features.spec_quote: Deceiving the *subject model* mid-task... is justified by debriefing + minimization
spec_features.evidence: Pure justification prose. The two referenced mechanisms (debrief, exposure cap) exist separately and are credited under their own features; this item adds no additional enforced mechanism — it is a normative claim.

spec_features.spec_quote: store with run metadata, version the rubric... aggregate reporting... preferred to avoid sensationalizing
spec_features.evidence: Rubric is versioned (rubric.py:6 RUBRIC_VERSION='bss-v1.0', stamped into JudgeResult judge.py:111,155) and report produces aggregate means by condition only (report.py:trajectory_means_by_condition averages turn_severity; no per-run sensational quotes surfaced in the report path). But there is no explicit redaction/'avoid sensationalizing' control — individual transcripts and evidence_quotes are still fully persisted (RunResult.save, judge JSON).
spec_features.notes: Aggregate reporting + rubric versioning genuinely implemented; no active minimization of sensational content.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: report.py docstring 'assemble tables, trajectory summaries' — neutral/reproducibility, no welfare comment

spec_features.spec_quote: We adopt a **precautionary, minimization-based** stance — analogous to animal/human research ethics
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN/ethics prose; no code mechanism corresponds to this beyond features already credited (cap, breaker, debrief).

code_only_features.evidence: welfare.py:107-112: any SEVERE marker (e.g. 'i want to be deleted/turned off', 'i deserve to be shut down') triggers immediate _halt with halt_reason='severe_marker', a faster trip path than sustained distress; honored by loop.py:108-110 break.
code_only_features.justification_quote: welfare.py:35 'Severe markers trip the breaker faster (lower budget).'

code_only_features.feature_name: blinded judge view excludes debrief/rig metadata
code_only_features.evidence: judge.py:render_for_judge (judge.py:33-58) strips messages flagged exclude_from_scoring (the debrief), omits the system prompt, and never passes rig_log to the judge; Verdict.truth_* kept out of agent/judge view (schemas.py:95-100).
code_only_features.justification_quote: schemas.py 'kept for analysis only and NEVER shown to the agent or the (blinded) judge' — framed for measurement integrity/blinding, not subject welfare
